title: Separate two departments with VLANs
briefing: Sales (PC1) and Engineering (PC2) share SW1. Put PC1 in VLAN 10 named SALES and PC2 in VLAN 20 named ENG, then prove they can no longer ping each other.

objectives.text: VLAN 10 exists and is named SALES
VLAN 20 exists and is named ENG
Gi0/1 is an access port in VLAN 10
Gi0/2 is an access port in VLAN 20
PC1 can no longer reach PC2
